_doc: [telecom_boed] W3-S11 canned conversation. users[i] is the incoming UserMessage text before agent turn i; agent[i] is the canned generate() output (text or a tool call).
users: Hi, my mobile data is really slow and pages barely load.
The status bar says airplane mode is on.

agent.text: Could you please check your status bar and tell me what you see?
Great, the issue is resolved now. Is there anything else I can help you with?
